messages:
Alex Thornton: quick heads-up — starting canary for eu-gen-v2 on prod in ~10m. where should I look for per-org+route logs? can someone create a saved search for org/model/route filters and suggest a temporary alert tweak for 5xx?
Maria Chen: use the Logsearch saved views — there's an existing eu-gen overview. link: https://logs.redwood.local/app/logs#/view/eu-gen-overview :point_left:
Maria Chen: example query you can use (Lucene):
```
org:\"acme\" AND model:\"eu-gen-v2\" AND route:\"/v1/generate\" AND status:[500 TO 599]
```
Maria Chen: if you want per-region split add `region:\"eu-west-1\"` to that.
Samir Patel: for the canary I'd lower sensitivity — suggest alert: 5xx rate > 3% sustained over 5m (current prod alert is 1%). also add a tag exclusion for internal health-checks.
Jess Rivera: I can create the saved search and wire it into the canary dashboard. assigning to me. will paste the saved search id here when done.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment started: eu-gen-v2 => canary-1841234567 (3 replicas). rollout: canary-1841234567.
Jess Rivera: saved search created: https://logs.redwood.local/app/logs#/view/saved/0ee7a9c3
Jess Rivera: here's the exact query I saved: 
```
{
  \"query\": \"org:\\\"acme\\\" AND model:\\\"eu-gen-v2\\\" AND route:\\\"/v1/generate\\\" AND status:[500 TO 599]\",\n  \"filters\": [\"region:eu-west-1\"]
}
```
Alex Thornton: perfect, thanks. can you also add that saved search link into the canary runbook and the PR notes?
Jess Rivera: done — added to runbook and to the canary PR description. PR: https://git.internal.redwood/repo/infra-alerts/pulls/431
Samir Patel: I'll open a small PR to adjust the alert threshold for the canary tag (will scope to env:canary). cc @Maria Chen for verification.
Maria Chen: looks good, just make sure alerting still snaps back to prod thresholds after canary window. add a scheduled job to revert or use a dynamic condition.
Alex Thornton: thanks everyone. I'll watch the saved search for 15m and report any anomalies here. :thumbsup:
Jess Rivera: noted — will add a temporary annotation on the dashboard for this canary window.
